newsitem.title: POLAND: Foreign bids PLN 1.7 bln at Polish T-bill tender.
newsitem.headline: Foreign bids PLN 1.7 bln at Polish T-bill tender.

text.p: Foreign investors placed bids worth 1.7 billion zlotys at the treasury's 1.3 billion zloty primary T-bill auction last Monday, the Rzeczpospolita daily reported a deputy central bank president as saying.
Witold Kozinski said this was the largest level of foreign bids placed at a T-bill tender this year, the daily said.
Total investor demand at the tender amounted to 4.7 billion zlotys and the treasury sold 1.4 billion zlotys worth of bills.

The central bank opened the flood gates for foreign investors by intervening against the zloty last week, which pushed the local unit 0.7 percentage point down to around 2.5 percent from the trading band centre.
